activity_context.topic_title: Writing Geometric Series in Sigma Notation

feedback.problem: The geometric series $2-10+50-250+1250$ can be expressed using sigma notation as
feedback.worked_solution:
We must express the given series in the form

$$
{\sum }_{n=1}^{N}{a}_{1}{r}^{n-1},
$$

where ${a}_{1}$ denotes the first term of the series, $r$ denotes the common ratio, and $N$ denotes the number of terms in the series. In this case, ${a}_{1}=2$ and $N=5.$

To find $r,$ we calculate the ratio of the first two terms in the series:

$$
r=\frac{{a}_{2}}{{a}_{1}}=\frac{-10}{2}=-5
$$

Therefore, expressing the given geometric series in sigma notation, we obtain:

$$
\begin{aligned}2-10+50-250+1250 & ={\sum }_{n=1}^{5}2\cdot (-5)^{n-1}\end{aligned}
$$
